experiences.title: Jungle Safari
experiences.description:
A visit to Jim Corbett is incomplete without experiencing the thrill of a jungle safari. Explore the forests, grasslands, and riverine ecosystems that make this region one of India's most celebrated wildlife destinations.

Guests can enjoy guided safari experiences that provide opportunities to spot wildlife in their natural habitat, including deer, elephants, wild boars, and hundreds of bird species. The park is also renowned for being home to the majestic Bengal tiger.
highlights: Located only 8 km from Jim Corbett National Park
Assistance with safari information and planning
Convenient access to major safari zones

experiences.title: Nature Walks
experiences.description:
Wake up to birdsong, enjoy peaceful morning walks, breathe clean forest air, and reconnect with nature at your own pace. Slow down and immerse yourself in the natural beauty surrounding the retreat. The forest-edge location of Corbett Foothills Retreat makes it ideal for leisurely walks through peaceful landscapes rich in flora and fauna.

Nature walks offer a chance to observe local wildlife, discover native plant species, enjoy fresh mountain air, and experience the tranquility that defines the Corbett region.

Perfect for families, couples, photographers, and anyone seeking a deeper connection with nature.

experiences.title: Bird Watching
experiences.description:
The forests and surrounding habitats of Jim Corbett are a paradise for bird enthusiasts. The region is home to hundreds of resident and migratory bird species, making it one of North India's most rewarding birdwatching destinations.

Early mornings are particularly magical, with the sounds of birds echoing through the forest canopy. Guests may encounter kingfishers, woodpeckers, hornbills, barbets, eagles, and numerous other species depending on the season. Whether you are an experienced birder or a curious beginner, birdwatching around the retreat is a peaceful and rewarding experience.

experiences.title: Organic Farming Experience
experiences.description:
Sustainability and responsible living are central to the philosophy of Corbett Foothills Retreat.

Guests are invited to explore our organic farming practices and learn how fresh produce is cultivated using environmentally conscious methods. This hands-on experience offers insights into sustainable agriculture and the benefits of farm-fresh ingredients.
highlights: A closer connection with nature and local traditions

experiences.title: Bonfire Evenings
experiences.description:
As dusk settles over the forest and the stars begin to light up the night sky, gather around a warm bonfire for an evening of relaxation and connection. Surrounded by the serenity of nature, these moments invite unhurried conversations, shared stories, and the simple pleasure of being together.

Whether with family, friends, or fellow travellers, bonfire evenings at Corbett Foothills Retreat create a memorable atmosphere where warmth, laughter, and lasting memories come naturally.

experiences.title: Family Getaways
experiences.description:
Create meaningful memories together amidst the tranquility of nature. With spacious suites, open lawns, nature-based activities, and a safe, welcoming environment, Corbett Foothills Retreat is the perfect destination for families to reconnect and unwind. Children can explore the outdoors, experience farm life, and discover nature, while parents relax and enjoy the slower pace of the retreat.

Whether it's sharing stories around a bonfire, enjoying leisurely walks, or simply spending quality time together, every moment here is designed to foster connection, relaxation, and lasting family memories.

experiences.title: Forest Stream Picnic
experiences.description:
Escape into the heart of the forest and spend a day beside a crystal-clear mountain stream, surrounded by the sights and sounds of nature. Cool waters, shaded woodland trails, and a thoughtfully arranged picnic create the perfect setting to relax, reconnect, and experience Corbett beyond the ordinary.

Whether you're sharing the experience with family, friends, or a loved one, this secluded forest retreat offers a refreshing blend of adventure, tranquility, and unforgettable moments in nature.

experiences.title: Forest Mornings & Sunset Views
experiences.description: At Corbett Foothills Retreat, some of the most memorable moments are the simplest ones. Wake up to the soothing sounds of birdsong, enjoy a peaceful cup of tea overlooking the forest, and breathe in the fresh mountain air as nature comes alive around you. As the day draws to a close, unwind amidst breathtaking sunset views, where the changing colours of the sky create a magical backdrop for relaxation and reflection. It is the perfect opportunity to slow down, reconnect with nature, and experience the tranquility that makes Corbett truly unforgettable.

experiences.title: Reconnect & Rejuvenate

Step away from the rush of everyday life and rediscover the joy of slowing down. Wake to birdsong, breathe in the fresh forest air, and immerse yourself in the calming rhythms of nature. Surrounded by serene landscapes and peaceful surroundings, Corbett Foothills Retreat offers the perfect setting to unwind, reflect, and recharge.

Whether enjoying quiet moments amidst nature, meaningful time with loved ones, or simply embracing the stillness around you, every experience here is designed to restore balance and rejuvenate the mind, body, and soul.

about.tagline: Corbett Foothills Retreat is where personalized hospitality meets the untamed beauty of the forest — a rare harmony between luxury and nature, where every guest is welcomed not as a visitor, but as part of a slower, more meaningful journey.
paragraphs: Nestled at the edge of the legendary Jim Corbett Forest, Corbett Foothills Retreat is not merely a destination — it is a thoughtfully curated sanctuary for travelers seeking authenticity, tranquility, and meaningful connection with nature. Conceived around a bespoke hospitality philosophy, the retreat offers an experience that is both intimate and deeply personal, where every stay is shaped by genuine care, attentive service, and an unwavering commitment to guest comfort.

Unlike large commercial resorts where guests often become just another room number, Corbett Foothills Retreat is a boutique farmstay with only six exclusive suites. This intentionally intimate scale allows the hosts to devote individual attention to every guest, understanding their unique preferences and creating experiences tailored to their needs. Whether it is arranging a memorable wildlife excursion, accommodating special dietary requirements, helping families plan activities, or simply ensuring a peaceful and comfortable stay, hospitality here is personal, thoughtful, and sincere.

Positioned in a privileged forest-edge location adjoining the wilderness of Corbett, the retreat offers uninterrupted views, pristine air, and a rare opportunity to experience nature in its purest form. Here, the rhythm of life slows down. Mornings begin with birdsong instead of traffic, evenings unfold beneath starlit skies, and the constant urgency of city life gradually gives way to a more mindful and restorative pace. Guests are invited to disconnect from schedules, screens, and distractions, and reconnect with nature, loved ones, and themselves.

A deep commitment to organic farming and sustainable living lies at the heart of the retreat's ethos. The property embraces responsible stewardship of the land through eco-conscious practices and farm-to-table experiences that celebrate freshness, seasonality, and local produce. Nature is not simply observed from a distance — it is woven into everyday life, creating an atmosphere that feels both grounding and rejuvenating.

Seamlessly balancing wilderness with comfort, Corbett Foothills Retreat offers contemporary conveniences thoughtfully integrated into the surrounding landscape. Every element has been designed to preserve the serenity of the environment while providing the warmth and refinement expected by modern travelers. This is more than a place to stay; it is a space to pause, breathe deeply, and embrace a gentler way of living.

ecoPractices.title: Traditional Earthen Seating
ecoPractices.description: Our common areas feature handcrafted earthen seating inspired by traditional Kumaoni village architecture. These mud-and-lime plastered platforms, known locally as 'chaukis', are naturally cool in summer, warm in winter, and represent our commitment to indigenous craftsmanship and low-impact design.

ecoPractices.title: Zero Plastic Footprint
ecoPractices.description: We have eliminated single-use plastics entirely from our operations. Glass water bottles are refilled from our own RO filtration system, toiletries are dispensed in refillable ceramic containers, and all packaging is compostable or recyclable. Guests receive jute tote bags for their safari essentials.

ecoPractices.title: Solar-Powered Operations
ecoPractices.description: The retreat runs on a hybrid solar power system that meets the majority of our energy needs. Solar water heaters serve all guest bathrooms, and energy-efficient LED lighting illuminates the property. We offset remaining consumption through tree-planting initiatives within the local community.

ecoPractices.title: Farm-to-Table Dining
ecoPractices.description: Our kitchen garden supplies seasonal vegetables, herbs, and spices that feature in every meal. Guests can walk through the gardens, pick their own produce, and watch as our chefs transform it into authentic Kumaoni cuisine. Nothing is wasted — organic waste is composted back into the soil.

ecoPractices.title: Rainwater Harvesting
ecoPractices.description: A comprehensive rainwater harvesting system captures monsoon runoff from every rooftop, replenishing the groundwater table and sustaining our irrigation needs throughout the dry months. The property also features a natural wastewater treatment pond that supports local biodiversity.

ecoPractices.title: Local Community Engagement
ecoPractices.description: We employ exclusively from nearby villages, source supplies from local artisans and farmers, and support village schools through our guest donation programme. Our guided walks often include visits to neighbouring hamlets where guests interact with families preserving centuries-old Kumaoni traditions.
